# Data: (gradient_flow_steps_K, mean_CAR, std_CAR, n_seeds, label)

    (15, 0.804, None,  1, 'Cutoff\n@15K'),

    (45, 0.764, None,  1, 'Cutoff\n@45K'),
    (50, 0.797, 0.032, 3, 'Full OCC\n(50K)'),
]

reverse = (15, 0.718, 0.025, 2, 'Reverse\nCutoff')
vanilla_car = 0.780
vanilla_std = 0.012

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.2))

# Vanilla reference band
ax.axhspan(vanilla_car - vanilla_std, vanilla_car + vanilla_std,
           color='#E8E8E8', zorder=0)
ax.axhline(vanilla_car, color='#999999', ls='--', lw=1.0, zorder=1,
           label=f'Vanilla ({vanilla_car:.3f})')

# Early cutoff series
xs = [d[0] for d in early_cutoff]
ys = [d[1] for d in early_cutoff]
errs = [d[2] if d[2] is not None else 0 for d in early_cutoff]
seeds = [d[3] for d in early_cutoff]

ax.plot(xs, ys, 'o-', color='#2166AC', markersize=7, zorder=3,
        label='Early cutoff progression')
for i, (x, y, e, n) in enumerate(zip(xs, ys, errs, seeds)):
    if e > 0:
        ax.errorbar(x, y, yerr=e, fmt='none', color='#2166AC',
                    capsize=3, capthick=1.0, lw=1.0, zorder=2)
    seed_label = f'n={n}'
    offset_y = 0.012 if i != 2 else -0.018  # push Cutoff@25K label down
    ax.annotate(seed_label, (x, y + offset_y), fontsize=6.5,
                ha='center', va='bottom', color='#555555')

# Reverse cutoff (separate marker)
rx, ry, re, rn, _ = reverse
ax.plot(rx, ry, 's', color='#B2182B', markersize=8, zorder=4,
        label='Reverse Cutoff (late 15K)')
ax.errorbar(rx, ry, yerr=re, fmt='none', color='#B2182B',
            capsize=3, capthick=1.0, lw=1.0, zorder=3)
ax.annotate(f'n={rn}', (rx, ry - 0.018), fontsize=6.5,
            ha='center', va='top', color='#555555')

# Styling
ax.set_xlabel('OCC gradient flow steps (K)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel('Collision Avoidance Rate (CAR)', fontsize=10)
ax.set_xticks([0, 15, 25, 35, 45, 50])
ax.set_xlim(-3, 53)
ax.set_ylim(0.68, 0.84)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0.70, 0.85, 0.02))

ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

ax.legend(loc='lower right', fontsize=7.5, framealpha=0.9,
          edgecolor='#CCCCCC', handlelength=1.5)

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.5)

out_dir = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / 'docs' / 'paper' / 'figures'
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'dose_response.pdf', bbox_inches='tight')
fig.savefig(out_dir / 'dose_response.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=200)
print(f'Saved to {out_dir}/dose_response.pdf')
